title: Foundation and clean-room baseline
exit: Repository, legal boundary, parity inventory, DSL and state foundations are accepted.

title: Single-node durable engine
exit: A PostgreSQL-backed standalone server survives process failure and runs scheduled workflows.

title: Workflow semantics and core runners
exit: Core flow control, files, errors, retries and process/container execution pass conformance tests.

title: Plugin platform and integration packs
exit: Third parties can build, test, publish and safely execute versioned plugins.

title: API, UI and self-service
exit: Users can author, launch, observe, debug and administer workflows without direct database access.

title: Open governance and enterprise-class controls
exit: Identity, tenancy, policy, audit, secrets, approvals and lineage are production-ready and fully OSS.

title: Distributed operations and reliability
exit: The platform scales horizontally, is observable, upgradeable, recoverable and security-hardened.

title: Compatibility, infrastructure as code and ecosystem
exit: Migration tooling, SDKs, GitOps, Terraform, operator and documentation support adoption.

title: Differentiation and general availability
exit: Differentiating features and GA quality targets are proven under reference workloads.
